{{Top|leg}}
'''Precipitator''' was a title within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A high-ranking official, they had autonomy and access to Imperial support and resources. [[Minas-Coth Cray]] was a Precipitator during the war.<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
